summary: Zhibao Technology filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its securities purchase agreement with non-U.S. investors and the closing of a $154.7 million PIPE financing. Investors delivered 2,380 Bitcoins (valued at $65,000 each) as full consideration. At closing, 395,678,152 PIPE units—each comprising one Class A ordinary share and one warrant—were delivered; the remaining 46,321,848 units are subject to shareholder approval for an authorized share capital increase. The filing is a routine capital-raising disclosure, not a special situation.
